options.label: Original reference
options.name: Model Home
options.subtitle: The original Georgetown model home
options.summary: The builder’s furnished home, preserved as our starting point. Classic trim, warm wood, patterned wallcoverings and statement lighting give each room its original character.

options.label: Option 1
options.name: Mineral & Walnut
options.subtitle: Warm modern living, with a boutique-hotel feel
options.status: Mineral & Walnut · Warm stone + original neutral palette
options.summary: Warm mineral walls, natural oak and rich walnut with selected pearl onyx-, quartzite- and limestone-look porcelain. Ivory, oatmeal and charcoal textiles preserve the original bedroom identities; exposed oak stairs connect the floors.

options.label: Option 2
options.name: Cocoa & Chrome
options.subtitle: Brown oak, polished stainless, white upholstery, blue & butter yellow
options.summary: Brown oak and polished stainless connect varied cabinet and console designs, all on solid bases without legs. White Cloud seating, warm stone walls, natural oak floors and off-white drapes frame blue artwork, small butter-yellow accents and plants.

floors: A luminous entry, tailored office, quiet cinema and uncluttered gym.
White seating, smoky brown oak, polished stainless and blue accents connect the entertaining rooms.
Related bedroom personalities with warm wood, grounded storage and oak floors.
A relaxed upper lounge, deeper guest suite and coordinated outdoor rooms.

options.label: Option 3
options.name: Collected Mineral
options.subtitle: Warm mineral architecture, your owned collection and considered new pieces
options.summary: Warm mineral walls, natural oak, walnut and selected stone-look finishes create a coherent home around all 39 pieces you already own. New selections complete the rooms, with coordinated lighting and a detailed contractor build brief.
